goal: NET configuration review: options binding, validation at startup and secrets outside appsettings.
use: NET configuration review: options binding, validation at startup and secrets outside appsettings. Use when a .NET service reads settings.

steps.note: List the options classes and where they are bound.
Check validation. Each options class should be validated at startup.
Check secrets. Flag secrets in appsettings or environment files committed to the repository.
Check environments. Flag development settings reachable in production.
Report. Each setting with file and line, the problem and the fix.
